text: {"lessons":["My account is still above its Period 1 value despite recent declines, so I should judge progress over a longer horizon rather than react to a few bad months.","Recent gains and losses have not made future price movements predictable; I should base trades on my plan, not on the price history.","Because losses weigh heavily on me and I rarely check the account, I should make deliberate, infrequent decisions and avoid trading just to ease short-term anxiety."]}
